description: This file contains tests for the Bedrock cross-region inference profile model mapping and cost calculation functions in the litellm project. It imports specific utility functions and data models, then defines test functions that validate model info retrieval and cost computations related to Bedrock models and proxy scenarios.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: A data class representing a model's response, including metadata, choices, and usage metrics.
classes.Choices: A data class representing a choice option in the model's response.
classes.Usage: A data class representing token usage information.
classes.Message: A data class representing a message in the chat completion model.

methods.name: test_bedrock_cross_region_inference_profile_mapping()
methods.description: Tests the mapping of a specific Bedrock model to its info, verifying provider and input cost.

methods.name: test_proxy_cost_calculation_scenario()
methods.description: Validates model info retrieval and cost calculation for a proxy model scenario, including assertions on cost values.
